name: b4_lin_dx_raw_zero_rows_m8
description: B4 Linear dx kernel tier, raw groups of 4: loss groups 0 and 4 in the zero state, live loss at absmax 1e-7; mantissas and exponents bit for bit. Zero groups (codes 0, stored = bias, E = 0) sit far above live data 25-30 binades lower: E_acc follows the groups holding a nonzero code, never a zero group's exponent (sections 13/14, zero groups), so the live bits survive.
